TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Sql Query
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE:
SELECT a.PROCESS_NAME, a.ERROR_MESSAGE, a.ERROR_DATE, a.PP_END_YEAR, a.PP_NUM
FROM ERROR_TBL a,
(SELECT b1.PROCESS_NAME, MAX(b1.ERROR_DATE) as ERROR_DATE FROM ERROR_TBL b1 WHERE b1.PP_END_YEAR = $$MAP_PP_END_YEAR AND b1.PP_NUM = $$MAP_PP_NUM -- AND -- b1.ERROR_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND b1.PROCESS_NAME in ('m_CPM_Load_CPM_NEWPAY_STG_TYPE_1_2_TBL', 'm_CPM_Load_CPM_NEWPAY_STG_ALT_TBL') GROUP BY b1.PROCESS_NAME ) b
WHERE a.PP_END_YEAR = $$MAP_PP_END_YEAR AND a.PP_NUM = $$MAP_PP_NUM AND a.ERROR_DATE = b.ERROR_DATE AND a.PROCESS_NAME = b.PROCESS_NAME

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: COUNT(*, PYF_REC_NO_PDT3 = '3' AND (IN(PYF_RSN_IDC, ' ', 'I', 'G') OR ISNULL(PYF_RSN_IDC)) AND (NOT IN(PYF_ADJ_RSN_IDC, 'T', 'Y', '1', '2', '3', '4') OR ISNULL(PYF_ADJ_RSN_IDC)) -- (NOT IN(PYF_ADJ_RSN_IDC, 'T', 'Y', '1', '2', '3', '4') AND NOT ISNULL(PYF_ADJ_RSN_IDC)) )
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: o_COUNT_DOE_TYPE_3_PROCESSED

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: COUNT(*, NOT ISNULL(MER_SSN) AND (MP_POOL_DES = ' ' OR ISNULL(MP_POOL_DES)) )
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: o_COUNT_MER_FOUND

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: COUNT(*, NOT ISNULL(PAD_SOC_SEC_NO) AND (MP_POOL_DES = ' ' OR ISNULL(MP_POOL_DES)) )
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: o_COUNT_PAD_FOUND

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: COUNT(*, NOT ISNULL(DYD_SSN_1) AND (MP_POOL_DES = ' ' OR ISNULL(MP_POOL_DES)) )
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: o_COUNT_YTD_FOUND

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: COUNT(*, NOT ISNULL(PSEUDOSSN) AND (MP_POOL_DES = ' ' OR ISNULL(MP_POOL_DES)) )
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: o_COUNT_PSEUDO_FOUND

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: 'Paymaster Counts for Pay Period: ' || TO_CHAR(PP_END_YEAR) || '-' || v_PP_NUM

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup condition
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: PP_END_YEAR = in_PP_END_YEAR AND PP_NUM = in_PP_NUM AND DYD_SSN_1 = in_DFAS_PSEUDO_SSN

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Sql Query
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE:
SELECT a.PP_END_YEAR, a.PP_NUM, a.DFAS_PSEUDO_SSN, COUNT(*) AS MULTIPLE_PAY_LINES FROM CPM_NEWPAY_TBL a WHERE a.PP_END_YEAR = $$MAP_PP_END_YEAR AND a.PP_NUM = $$MAP_PP_NUM AND a.MP_POOL_DES != ' '
GROUP BY a.PP_END_YEAR, a.PP_NUM, a.DFAS_PSEUDO_SSN
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
